summary: Applied both spec-review repairs: separated current-context target guards from display lookups and required worktree-mode runId resolution.

items.title: RunId/spec lookup is conflated with execution-context guarding
items.rationale: The spec now requires --expect-spec and --expect-run-id style checks against the current dispatcher context and marks positional runId status as display-only.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[R2], acceptance_criteria, clarifications, overview.data_flow, and T-1 now distinguish current-context assertions from runId display lookup.

items.title: RunId target behavior omits active worktree resolution
items.rationale: The spec now requires active worktree-mode runId lookup/guard behavior and tests for that compatibility path.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[R5], acceptance_criteria, overview.decisions, and T-1 now require active worktree flow.json resolution through active-flow registry/worktree state.
